decision_rule: Choose explicit_support or explicit_negation only for direct target evidence; use protocol_artifact when fixed prompts or task material explain the signal.
Prefer participant for subject speech/text, interviewer for prompt-led evidence, scale_item for explicit questionnaire/clinical rating evidence.
0 means none/contradictory/insufficient, 1 means weak or indirect, 2 means clear direct evidence.
Use current only for present symptom evidence; avoid upgrading past or hypothetical mentions to current symptoms.
Use yes when the evidence is mainly induced by a prompt, fixed question, task text, or protocol cue rather than participant symptom expression.
For death/self-harm targets, do not infer from mood, distress, or general severity; require explicit scale item or direct clinical text evidence.
